title: Lutiyan Gaiyan Ridawan Aa Cheti Veer Ghazi
body:
Dariya Day Pasay Zainab Devay Payi Sadawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Tere Asray Tay Zainab Vich Karbala Te Aagayi
Abbas Maut Teri Meray Maan Sab Muka Gayi
Hun Zaalima Ton Apna Main Poor Kinj Bachawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaimay Vi Sar Gaye Nai Parday Vi Lut Gaye Nay
Jinnay Vi Asray San Abbas Tut Gaye Nay
Barjayan Tay Bhena Day Parday Main Kinj Banawa
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri Ladli Nu Ban Vich Mu Tay Tamachay Maray
Zaalim Shimar Nay Odhay Kannan Chon Dur Utaray
Tere Baaj Sakina Nu Mileya Nay Ay Sazawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Hattan Ch Shamiyan Nay Rassiyan Jado Pawaiyan
Ro Ro Kay Bibiya San Reya Dendiyan Duhaiyan
Zainab Nu Yaad Aiyan Haye Ghazi Diyan Baahwan
<<DIVIDER>>
Aulad-e-Fatima Nu Har Shehar Vich Phirauna
Inna Zalima Nay Ghazi Sanu Shaam Lay Kay Jaana
Bay Qafan Chad Kay Sab Nu Keewain Main Shaam Jawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Assa Pyaaseya Nu Shaami Pani Paye Vakhaunday
Sanu Vakha Vakha Kay Oontha Nu Pay Pilonday
Manzar Aye Pyaaseya Ton Abbas Kinj Lukawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Bardash Jera Keeta Karbal Ch Syeda Nay
Abbas Day Laashay Ton Leya Badla Shamiya Nay
Lafzan De Vich Asad O Manzar Main Kinj Wakhawan
